output_text: This is a personal knowledge base for infrastructure, server setup and CLI workflows. Target system: Debian / Ubuntu. `guides/` – step-by-step instructions (runbook-style) `cheatsheets/` – quick-reference commands `templates/` – copy-paste-ready config files (.bashrc, Makefile, docker-compose.yml, nginx.conf) `scripts/` – reusable bash scripts `theory/` – conceptual reference material (German, imported from another project) All documentation is written in English. Keep it that way. **Exception:** Files in `theory/` are written in German. These were imported from another project and will stay in German.
